name: trace-core
title: Trace core (TraceSpan + pure helpers)
description: Shared data contracts and pure, total helpers for the trace-native observability components: the TraceSpan type (phoenix/langfuse/OTel-GenAI intersection), timestamp/duration math, bar-layout geometry, tree flatten + transcript row model, ChatML parsing, cost aggregation, layered graph layout, attribute grouping, and structural trace alignment.
